messages:
alex: Quick shoulder tap — we're deciding whether the edge should keep doing proto-first + gRPC inside or translate to HTTP/JSON at the gateway. Thinking about telemetry/quotas and console UX. Opinions?

maria: If we keep gRPC internal we get typed contracts and smaller payloads, but browser clients will need gRPC-web or a translation layer.

shay: +1 for proto-first for internal services. For the console and external routes we can expose JSON endpoints. That keeps dev ergonomics on the UI side.

eric: Concern: Envoy transcoding adds a LOT of edge complexity and subtle metric mismatches. Quota accounting in the console needs token counts — transcoding can hide original proto sizes.

julie: Could we emit a canonical telemetry extraction before transcoding? Eg gateway attaches proto_metadata:{method, proto_size, fields_count} then we drive quotas/console off that.

alex: That helps. Also worried about streaming — many models/routers use server-stream and gRPC supports real bidi/stream semantics. Translating to chunked HTTP or SSE is messy.

maria: For streaming routes we should probably keep pure gRPC and mark them as "internal-only" or "dedicated-edge". Browser-facing routes typically don't need full bidi.

eric: On rollout: proposal = start proto-first internally, add a lightweight JSON facade for public routes that copies canonical telemetry fields, then canary the facade in console to make sure quotas/graphs look identical.

shay: +1. Also add a compatibility header: `x-rw-original-proto-md5` so we can correlate proto vs json calls in traces.

ci-bot: CI: run integration-tests/gateway-transcode on canary deploys — failing tests will block rollout.

julie: UX note: console should surface a "protocol" column on routes and a toggle to view metrics by proto or by facade. That avoids confusing users when numbers shift during rollout.

alex: Agree. Action items: 1) Eric + Maria prototype telemetry extraction hook in gateway. 2) Shay + Julie mock console toggle and sample graphs. 3) Eric set up canary test pipeline with ci-bot. 4) I'll draft a short runbook for streaming exceptions. Plan to start canary next week. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll make a tiny proto change to include a stable method id in metadata so the gateway can carry it easily.

eric: I'll draft the Envoy filter POC and share logs format. Expect subtle diffs, will add mapping tests.

shay: If we can, let's avoid heavy runtime reflection. Prefer explicit mapping config per route so it's auditable.

alex: Good call. Keep mappings explicit. Thanks team — we'll sync in the weekly eng-platform meeting and spin up the POC channel if needed.
